# Testing services with dependencies

When you add a dependency to your service, you must also include it in your tests. For isolated tests, pass an instance of the injectable dependency class into the serviceΓÇÖs constructor. Using the `inject` function can add complexity. Injecting the real service is often impractical because dependent services can be difficult to create and control. Instead, mock the dependency, use a dummy value, or create a spy on the relevant service method. By using the TestBed testing utility, you can let AngularΓÇÖs dependency injection handle service creation and manage constructor argument order.
